tools.name: ask_hermes
tools.description: Ask Hermes — the operator's personal homelab and life AI assistant — a question and get an answer back. Call this whenever the user wants Hermes to answer a question, look something up, check homelab/infrastructure status, or reason about a problem. Pass the user's full natural-language question as `query`.

query.description: The user's full natural-language question for Hermes.
